records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, North Studio!
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

Glad to have North Studio on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 ([email:4b67eadb] welcome), customer engaged enough to file and close a ticket and attend the Aug 3 call ([calendar:704e1635]), but no email replies, no invites sent, and two unanswered nudges ([email:0ea4ddfd], [email:07ef941a]) in 8 remaining days suggest slow momentum.

draft.subject: Following up after our call
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week, and good to hear the notification badge ticket came back fixed on our side.

Now that North Studio's first project is up, the usual next step is getting a teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

If it's easier, I'm happy to walk through that first invite with you on a short call this week.

Best,
Nadia
